About.title: ABOUT US
About.subtitle: SOLID TESTING, BUILDING TRUST.
About.intro1_part1: Hoang Anh Trading & Construction JSC - LAS-XD 40.009 Building Materials Laboratory is a leading entity in Vietnam's Trading and Construction industry, specializing in on-site testing services for transportation infrastructure projects nationwide.
About.intro1_part2: With a team of highly experienced engineers, professionally trained and supported by modern equipment and machinery, we provide a full range of on-site testing services, including:
About.intro1_part3:
- Road foundation and subgrade testing
- Soil compaction and moisture testing
- On-site concrete and asphalt testing
- Pile testing (PDA, PIT, static load testing, etc.)
- Monitoring and quality inspection of construction works
About.intro2: With a team of highly experienced engineers, professionally trained and supported by modern equipment and machinery, we provide a full range of on-site testing services, including:

Projects.title: OUR PROJECTS
Projects.subtitle: Discover our portfolio of successful projects across various sectors.
Projects.project1Description: The Onyx Tower is a high-end commercial and residential complex, featuring modern architecture and luxurious amenities. Located in the city center, this project is a symbol of development and prosperity.
Projects.project2Description: Lumina Residences is a green, peaceful living community, offering an ideal living space for families. With a design that harmonizes with nature, Lumina Residences is a place to settle down and thrive.
Projects.project3Description: Horizon Industrial Park is a modern manufacturing facility designed to meet the needs of heavy industries. With advanced infrastructure and a strategic location, Horizon is a top choice for businesses.
Projects.project4Description: Glass Pavilion Gallery is a unique renovation project, transforming an old space into a modern, minimalist glass architecture. It is an ideal space for art events and exhibitions.
Projects.project5Description: The Vertex Plaza is a bustling commercial and entertainment center, attracting thousands of visitors daily. With high-end shops, diverse restaurants, and entertainment areas, Vertex Plaza is a must-visit destination.
Projects.project6Description: Serenity Gardens is a high-end residential area with modern villa and townhouse designs, set in a lush, tranquil green space. The project offers comfortable living and closeness to nature.
Projects.projectTuyenQuangTitle: Tuyen Quang - Ha Giang Expressway Project
Projects.projectTuyenQuangDesc: The project involves the construction of an expressway connecting Tuyen Quang and Ha Giang, contributing to economic development and trade between the two provinces. The project includes components such as expressway roads, bridges, and traffic safety systems.
Projects.projectTinhHucDesc: The Tinh Huc Bridge construction project is an important transportation structure, connecting neighboring areas, contributing to improving transportation infrastructure and promoting local economic development.
